subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds words with the digraphs, blends and double consonants taught this year; reads phonics words in texts; spells ten words a week

show.line: Let's read a little text. The boy has a toy train. It runs on the track. Read it with me!

rounds.prompt: Read the first sentence out loud.
accept: the boy has a toy train
a boy has a toy train

rounds.prompt: Read the text. What does the boy have?
Which word is missing? The dog, gap, at the cat.
rounds.praise: Barks! The dog barks at the cat.

rounds.prompt: Spell the word. Listen. d-r-e-s-s. Which card is spelled right?
rounds.praise: Yes! Dress, with two of the last letter.

rounds.story: Joy has a doll in a red dress. They play in the stream. Where do they play?

hints: Read one word at a time. Sound out the hard ones.
Look at the picture. Does your reading make sense?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this sentence. The boy has a toy train.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The boy has a toy tray!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That word is train, not tray. The toy train.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. The boy has a toy train!

parent_line: Can read a short text made of words with this year's sounds.
